# Tasks allowed to re-run when ONLY the version stamp changes (#3464).
#
# Read by .github/scripts/stamp-invariance.py. One Gradle task path per line; a trailing `*` matches
# every task in that project. Everything else that re-runs under a changed `-Pversion` is a leak.
#
# Adding a line here is the visible cost of reading KuiltVersion. A module that starts depending on
# `:kuilt-base` adds its own tasks here IN THE SAME PR, and says so in the PR body: on native and
# wasm every snapshot recompiles that module, and everything above it, because the version is
# compiled into `:kuilt-base`'s klib on every run.

# The carrier itself, including `generateKuiltVersion`, which writes the version into its source.
:kuilt-base:*

# `writeBinaryenCoordinates` packs the module's own published coordinates (version included) into
# its main jar, so the runtime can fetch the classified wasm-opt jars of the same version. Only
# the resource and the tests that load it change per snapshot; no compile does.
:kuilt-warp-compiler:jvmTest
